Agent 应用最终落到推理系统上。到了 Serving 层，“多个 Agent 能否共享 KV Cache”不再是简单的 yes / no，而取决于请求是否具有兼容且完全一致的 token prefix，以及 inference engine 的 cache key、生命周期和 isolation policy。

FIG.10.1 · PREFIX KV REUSE

共享的是已计算前缀，不是一个可变会话对象

Prefix Cache 命中后只跳过共享前缀的 Prefill；分叉后的 suffix 和后续 Decode 仍属于各自请求。

01

Shared Prefix

System Prompt · Tool Schema · Stable Policy → 完全一致的 token prefix
02

Prefix Cache Lookup

Radix tree / block hash 等机制找到最长可复用前缀
03

Prefill Suffix

只计算未缓存的 Agent-specific / User-specific suffix
04

Decode

每个请求继续自己的 token-by-token generation
核心边界

Prefix caching primarily reduces Prefill / TTFT; Decode remains a separate cost.

10.1 Prefill、Decode 与两种 KV 复用

机制复用范围主要价值
Within-request KV Cache同一请求已处理 token避免 Decode 时重复计算全部历史
Cross-request Prefix Cache不同请求之间兼容且完全相同的 token prefix避免重复 Prefill，降低 TTFT

没有跨请求 Prefix Cache 时，相同前缀通常仍会被各自 Prefill。现代 serving engine 是否默认启用、如何索引和何时淘汰都取决于 engine、version 与 config，因此不要把“默认不能共享”当成通用事实。

10.2 Cache Hit 需要 token-level identity

KEY常见兼容条件
model / revision · tokenizer · chat template · exact token IDs · position semantics · adapter / LoRA · multimodal identity · cache namespace / salt · block granularity
MISS常见命中率杀手
动态 timestamp / request id · Tool Schema 顺序变化 · 不稳定 JSON serialization · tenant 信息过早注入 · role prompt 过早分叉
PROMPT LAYOUT

Prefix Cache 的命中率部分取决于应用层 Prompt Layout。把稳定公共前缀放在前面、动态内容放在后面，通常更容易复用；但绝不能为了命中率破坏语义、权限或租户隔离。

10.3 SGLang RadixAttention vs vLLM APC

RuntimePrefix 索引思路共同目标
SGLangRadix-style prefix tree / longest-prefix reuse复用已经计算的精确共享前缀 KV，避免重复 Prefill
vLLMBlock-oriented APC；使用 prefix-aware block hash 查找已计算 blocks复用已经计算的精确共享前缀 KV，避免重复 Prefill

RadixAttention 是 SGLang 的具体机制/术语，不应该当作所有 Prefix Caching 的通用名称。不同 runtime 可以使用不同数据结构达到同样的跨请求前缀复用目标。

10.4 Prefix Cache ≠ Semantic Cache

CacheKey复用什么是否仍调用模型
KV / Prefix Cacheexact compatible token prefixintermediate K/V computation是：suffix / Decode 仍需执行
Exact Response Cacheexact request keyfinal response通常否
Semantic Cacheembedding / semantic similarityprior response / tool result命中时可跳过
必须区分

Prefix caching reuses computation. Semantic caching reuses an answer.

10.5 Multi-Agent：先保留边界，再优化共享前缀

Common System Policy
+ Common Tool Schema
+ Stable Safety / Formatting Rules
        ↓ shared prefix

Agent-specific Role / Skill Context
        ↓ divergence

User / Task Context

不要为了 Cache Hit 强行让所有 Agent 使用相同角色定义。先保证责任边界、权限隔离与语义正确，再优化共享前缀。

10.6 Security：Cache sharing 也是隔离策略

SHARE更高复用
更高 prefix hit rate · 更少 Prefill · 更低 TTFT；适合同一 trust group 内大量公共前缀。
ISOLATE更强隔离
通过 cache namespace / salt 限制跨用户或跨租户复用，牺牲部分命中率换取隐私边界。
vLLM CACHE SALT

vLLM 当前支持 request-level cache_salt，把 salt 混入 Prefix Cache key。不同 salt 的请求不能共享缓存 blocks，可用于降低跨租户 prefix timing side-channel 风险。

10.7 Serving Metrics：用 workload 证明收益

指标回答什么问题
prefix-cache hit rate有多少请求真正复用了公共前缀？
cached-prefix tokens / request每次命中到底省掉多少 Prefill？
TTFT P50 / P95 / P99首 token 延迟是否真的改善？
prefill / request throughput释放的计算是否转化成吞吐？
KV utilization / eviction缓存收益是否被显存压力与淘汰抵消？
cost per successful taskServing 优化最终是否改善业务单位成本？

10.8 面试回答

回答结构

多个 Agent 能否复用 KV Cache，要看它们是否由支持 Prefix Caching 的 serving engine 承载，以及请求是否拥有兼容且完全一致的 token prefix。没有跨请求 Prefix Cache 时会重复 Prefill；使用 SGLang Radix-style cache 或 vLLM APC 后，后续请求可以复用已计算的共享前缀 KV blocks，只计算分叉后的 suffix。这里共享的是 immutable prefix computation，不是可变会话状态。它主要优化 Prefill / TTFT，不直接减少 Decode；Semantic Cache 则是另一层的 response reuse。生产上还必须考虑 Prompt 对齐、cache eviction 和 multi-tenant isolation / cache salt。

SOURCE BOUNDARY

本章由用户提供的多 Agent KV Cache 视频总结出发，并用 vLLM、SGLang、Hugging Face 与 Redis 官方资料校正：不把“默认不能共享”当通则；区分 Prefix Cache 与 Semantic Cache；补充 token-level identity、Prefill/Decode 边界和多租户安全。

2026-09-28 · 验证边界

Codex 当前 Linux 源码使用 bubblewrap + seccomp；Cloud 默认禁网指 agent 阶段，setup 可联网。Prefix Cache 不直接减少 Decode 计算；salt 应由可信服务注入且不可预测。Firecracker / CubeSandbox 性能只按来源测试条件解读，本次未复现。

Agent Sandbox：把执行能力限制在可证明的 Blast Radius 内 §10.S

Sandbox 不是 VM 的同义词，而是受控执行边界。真正需要同时约束 filesystem、network、process/syscall、resource、credential、lifecycle 与 audit；模型只负责提出动作，Host/Sandbox Policy 才拥有真实执行权。

FIG.10.S1 · SANDBOX CONTROL PLANE

Approval 控制意图，Sandbox 限制能力

把 Agent proposal、权限决策、运行时隔离、执行证据与验证串成一条可审计链。

01

Agent Proposal

run command · install package · write file · connect endpoint；模型表达意图，但没有直接宿主权限。
02

Permission / Risk Gate

根据 action、scope、tenant、risk、approval 与 policy 决定是否允许进入执行层。
03

Sandbox Scheduler

选择 image / template、writable roots、network policy、CPU / memory / disk / PID / timeout 与 secret strategy。
04

Isolated Runtime

OS sandbox / container / gVisor-like / microVM / constrained runtime 在技术层强制 filesystem、process 与 egress 边界。
05

Evidence + Validation

command、exit code、file diff、network、resource、policy decision 与 artifact validation 回写 Trace；失败可 kill / reset / rollback。
核心原则

The model proposes an action; the sandbox enforces the physical capability boundary.

FIG.10.S2 · ISOLATION PATTERN MATRIX

不要做“process < container < microVM”的单轴排行榜

选型变量

真实安全性还取决于 mounts、credentials、egress、host services、kernel/hypervisor patching、escape hatch、image provenance 与 runtime configuration。隔离技术名词本身不能替代 threat model。

FIG.10.S3 · VERIFIED IMPLEMENTATION SNAPSHOT

把产品事实和通用架构分开

Implementation 已验证边界 不要误写成

Secret Rule

The safest secret in a sandbox is the secret that never enters it.

Benchmark Rule

启动时间与内存数字必须带 workload、hardware、snapshot/template、guest size 与 concurrency 条件；不要把 vendor benchmark 当成跨产品恒定事实。

Production Multi-Tenant Agent：把 Tenant Isolation 做成控制面 §10.T

真正的多租户边界不是用 Prompt 告诉模型不要看别人数据，而是：即使模型、Router 或 Tool Arguments 出错，Tenant A 的执行仍然无法读取、修改、调用或推断 Tenant B 的受保护资源。

FIG.10.T1 · TENANT ISOLATION CONTROL PLANE

Tenant Context 必须从身份层贯穿到每一个资源访问点

tenant_id 是可信安全上下文，不是允许模型自由改写的 Agent State。

01 · IDENTITY

User / Service → Trusted Tenant Context

Identity Provider 解析 user / service identity，并绑定 tenant_id、role、entitlement。Prompt 和 LLM output 不能覆盖这个上下文。
02 · POLICY

Principal + Tenant + Action + Resource

Authentication 只回答是谁；Authorization 判断动作；Tenant Isolation 继续限制这个执行永远只能触达哪个资源宇宙。
03 · RUNTIME

State · Memory · RAG · Tools · Cache · Jobs

每个共享面都必须 tenant-scoped：Checkpoint、Retriever、MCP credential、Queue envelope、Cache namespace、Sandbox 与 Trace 都不能丢失租户上下文。
04 · RESOURCE

Storage Policy · Credential Broker · Namespace · RLS

最终资源层继续 fail closed：数据库、对象存储、Vector Store 和外部 SaaS 通过 policy、namespace、RLS 或 tenant-scoped credential 做第二道边界。
05 · VERIFY

Audit · Negative Tests · Quotas · Fairness

上线验证不只测自己能访问自己，还要主动猜别人的 thread/document、篡改 tenant context、碰撞 cache、重放 checkpoint，并做 per-tenant noisy-neighbor load test。
核心原则

The agent may be wrong; the infrastructure must still make cross-tenant access fail closed.

FIG.10.T2 · ISOLATION SURFACE MATRIX

多租户事故通常发生在主数据之外的共享面

FIG.10.T3 · DEPLOYMENT SPECTRUM

Pooled / Bridge / Silo 是逐资源的选择，不是整个系统一个开关

POOLED

Shared Runtime + Logical Isolation

高利用率、低成本；要求强 tenant policy、严格 credential boundary 和持续 cross-tenant test。
BRIDGE

Shared Control Plane + Selective Isolation

默认 pooled；按 tenant、risk、tier 或 compliance 给特定 storage / compute / sandbox 独立资源。
SILO

Dedicated Resource Boundary

更小 cross-tenant blast radius，但增加成本、容量碎片与 fleet lifecycle 复杂度。
不要漏掉性能隔离

Tenant Isolation 不只防数据越界。共享 LLM、Queue、Tool API、Cache 和 Sandbox 还需要 per-tenant / tier concurrency、token、tool、storage 与 cost budget，避免 noisy neighbor。

en:
Agent applications ultimately run on an inference system. At the serving layer, whether multiple Agents can share KV cache is not a simple yes/no question; it depends on compatible identical token prefixes plus the inference engine's cache key, lifecycle, and isolation policy.

FIG.10.1 · PREFIX KV REUSE

Reuse computed immutable prefixes, not one mutable session cache

A prefix-cache hit skips Prefill for the shared prefix only; the divergent suffix and later Decode remain request-specific.

01

Shared Prefix

System Prompt · Tool Schema · Stable Policy → identical token prefix
02

Prefix Cache Lookup

A radix tree, block hash, or similar mechanism finds the reusable prefix
03

Prefill Suffix

Compute only the uncached Agent-specific or user-specific suffix
04

Decode

Each request continues its own token-by-token generation
Core boundary

Prefix caching primarily reduces Prefill / TTFT; Decode remains a separate cost.

10.1 Prefill, Decode, and two kinds of KV reuse

MechanismReuse scopePrimary value
Within-request KV CachePast tokens in the same requestAvoid recomputing the full history during Decode
Cross-request Prefix CacheCompatible identical token prefixes across requestsAvoid redundant Prefill and reduce TTFT

Without cross-request prefix caching, identical prefixes are typically prefilled separately. Whether modern serving engines enable it by default, how they index it, and when they evict entries depend on the engine, version, and configuration, so 'sharing is disabled by default' is not a universal fact.

10.2 Cache hits require token-level identity

KEYTypical compatibility factors
model / revision · tokenizer · chat template · exact token IDs · position semantics · adapter / LoRA · multimodal identity · cache namespace / salt · block granularity
MISSCommon hit-rate killers
dynamic timestamps / request IDs · changing tool-schema order · unstable JSON serialization · tenant data inserted too early · early role-specific divergence
PROMPT LAYOUT

Prefix-cache hit rate is partly an application prompt-layout property. Stable common prefixes placed earlier and dynamic content later are usually easier to reuse, but cache efficiency must never override semantics, authorization, or tenant isolation.

10.3 SGLang RadixAttention vs vLLM APC

RuntimePrefix indexing approachShared goal
SGLangRadix-style prefix tree / longest-prefix reuseReuse already-computed KV for exact shared prefixes and avoid redundant Prefill
vLLMBlock-oriented APC with prefix-aware block hashesReuse already-computed KV for exact shared prefixes and avoid redundant Prefill

RadixAttention is an SGLang-specific mechanism and term, not the generic name for all prefix caching. Different runtimes can use different data structures to achieve the same cross-request prefix-reuse goal.

10.4 Prefix Cache ≠ Semantic Cache

CacheKeyWhat is reusedModel call after hit?
KV / Prefix Cacheexact compatible token prefixintermediate K/V computationYes: suffix / Decode still run
Exact Response Cacheexact request keyfinal responseUsually no
Semantic Cacheembedding / semantic similarityprior response / tool resultCan be skipped on hit
Must distinguish

Prefix caching reuses computation. Semantic caching reuses an answer.

10.5 Multi-Agent: preserve boundaries first, then optimize shared prefixes

Common System Policy
+ Common Tool Schema
+ Stable Safety / Formatting Rules
        ↓ shared prefix

Agent-specific Role / Skill Context
        ↓ divergence

User / Task Context

Do not force all Agents to share one role definition merely to improve cache hits. Preserve responsibility boundaries, permission isolation, and semantic correctness first; optimize shared prefixes second.

10.6 Security: cache sharing is also an isolation policy

SHAREMore sharing
Higher prefix hit rate · less Prefill · lower TTFT; useful when a trust group legitimately shares common prefixes.
ISOLATEStronger isolation
Use cache namespaces or salts to restrict cross-user or cross-tenant reuse, trading some hit rate for privacy isolation.
vLLM CACHE SALT

vLLM currently supports request-level cache_salt, mixing the salt into prefix-cache keys. Requests with different salts cannot share cached blocks, reducing cross-tenant prefix timing side-channel risk.

10.7 Serving metrics: prove value with workload evidence

MetricQuestion answered
prefix-cache hit rateHow many requests actually reused a common prefix?
cached-prefix tokens / requestHow much Prefill does each hit avoid?
TTFT P50 / P95 / P99Did first-token latency actually improve?
prefill / request throughputDid saved computation translate into throughput?
KV utilization / evictionAre cache benefits offset by memory pressure and eviction?
cost per successful taskDid serving optimization improve business unit economics?

10.8 Interview answer

Answer structure

Whether multiple Agents can reuse KV cache depends on whether they are served by an engine with prefix caching and whether their requests share a compatible identical token prefix. Without cross-request prefix caching, Prefill is repeated; with mechanisms such as SGLang's radix-style cache or vLLM APC, later requests can reuse cached KV blocks for the shared prefix and compute only the divergent suffix. What is shared is immutable prefix computation, not mutable session state. This primarily optimizes Prefill and TTFT, not Decode; semantic caching is a separate response-reuse layer. Production systems must also consider prompt alignment, cache eviction, and multi-tenant isolation or cache salts.

SOURCE BOUNDARY

This chapter starts from the user-provided multi-Agent KV-cache video summary and is corrected against official vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face, and Redis material: it avoids treating 'no sharing by default' as a universal rule, separates prefix caching from semantic caching, and adds token-level identity, Prefill/Decode boundaries, and multi-tenant security.

2026-09-28 · Verification boundaries

Current Codex Linux source uses bubblewrap + seccomp. Cloud internet defaults apply to the agent phase; setup can use the network. Prefix caching does not directly reduce decode computation; a trusted service must supply unpredictable salts. Firecracker and CubeSandbox performance claims apply to their published test conditions and were not reproduced here.

Agent Sandbox: constrain execution to a provable blast radius §10.S

A sandbox is not synonymous with a VM; it is a controlled execution boundary. A production design constrains filesystem, network, process/syscalls, resources, credentials, lifecycle, and audit. The model proposes actions; the host and sandbox policy hold actual execution authority.

FIG.10.S1 · SANDBOX CONTROL PLANE

Approval controls intent; sandboxing constrains capability

Connect agent proposals, permission decisions, runtime isolation, execution evidence, and validation into one auditable chain.

01

Agent Proposal

run command · install package · write file · connect endpoint; the model expresses intent but does not directly hold host authority.
02

Permission / Risk Gate

Use action, scope, tenant, risk, approval, and policy to decide whether execution is allowed.
03

Sandbox Scheduler

Select image/template, writable roots, network policy, CPU/memory/disk/PID/time limits, and secret strategy.
04

Isolated Runtime

An OS sandbox, container, gVisor-like runtime, microVM, or constrained runtime enforces filesystem, process, and egress boundaries.
05

Evidence + Validation

Commands, exit codes, file diffs, network activity, resource use, policy decisions, and artifact validation return to the trace; failures can be killed, reset, or rolled back.
Core rule

The model proposes an action; the sandbox enforces the physical capability boundary.

Production Multi-Tenant Agents: make tenant isolation a control plane §10.T

A real multi-tenant boundary is not a prompt telling the model to avoid other customers' data. Even when the model, router, or tool arguments are wrong, an execution for Tenant A must still be unable to read, mutate, invoke, or infer Tenant B's protected resources.

FIG.10.T1 · TENANT ISOLATION CONTROL PLANE

Tenant context must flow from identity to every resource access point

tenant_id is trusted security context, not agent state that the model is allowed to rewrite.

01 · IDENTITY

User / Service → Trusted Tenant Context

The identity provider resolves user or service identity and binds tenant_id, roles, and entitlements. Prompts and model output cannot override this context.
02 · POLICY

Principal + Tenant + Action + Resource

Authentication answers who the caller is; authorization evaluates the action; tenant isolation further constrains which resource universe the execution can ever touch.
03 · RUNTIME

State · Memory · RAG · Tools · Cache · Jobs

Every shared surface must be tenant-scoped: checkpoints, retrievers, MCP credentials, queue envelopes, cache namespaces, sandboxes, and traces must not lose tenant context.
04 · RESOURCE

Storage Policy · Credential Broker · Namespace · RLS

The resource layer continues to fail closed: databases, object stores, vector stores, and external SaaS use policy, namespaces, RLS, or tenant-scoped credentials as a second boundary.
05 · VERIFY

Audit · Negative Tests · Quotas · Fairness

Release verification must test more than valid self-access: actively guess another tenant's thread or document, tamper with tenant context, collide caches, replay checkpoints, and run per-tenant noisy-neighbor load tests.
Core rule

The agent may be wrong; the infrastructure must still make cross-tenant access fail closed.

Compute / QuotaGlobal throttling onlyper-tenant concurrency · token/tool/cost budgets · fair queueing
FIG.10.T3 · DEPLOYMENT SPECTRUM

Pooled, bridge, and silo are per-resource choices, not one global system switch

POOLED

Shared Runtime + Logical Isolation

High utilization and lower cost, but requires strong tenant policies, strict credential boundaries, and continuous cross-tenant testing.
BRIDGE

Shared Control Plane + Selective Isolation

Pool by default, but dedicate selected storage, compute, or sandboxes based on tenant, risk, tier, or compliance.
SILO

Dedicated Resource Boundary

Reduces cross-tenant blast radius but increases cost, capacity fragmentation, and fleet lifecycle complexity.
Do not forget performance isolation

Tenant isolation is not only about data boundaries. Shared LLMs, queues, tool APIs, caches, and sandboxes also need per-tenant or tier concurrency, token, tool, storage, and cost budgets to prevent noisy neighbors.

External verification date: 2026-09-23. Implementation examples include AWS multi-tenant agentic AI guidance, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, Pinecone namespaces, and vLLM prefix-cache salting. These are implementation evidence; the handbook's core rule remains a vendor-neutral tenant-isolation control plane.

Agent Runtime Control Plane: project runtime context + identity/policy §10.R

A repository is only the explicit input. Deliverable coding-agent work also requires reproducible project runtime context plus identity, authorization, and credential controls outside the model.

FIG.10.R1 · PROJECT RUNTIME CONTEXT

Beyond the repository lies an entire implicit layer required to make the project actually run

TOOLCHAIN

runtime · build tools · plugins

versioned image / setup
CONFIG / DATA

env schema · DB baseline · migrations

safe defaults · fixtures · seed data
DEPENDENCIES

services · mocks · network policy

allow / deny · upstream / test double
FEEDBACK

logs · health · exit status

structured evidence for repair
VERIFICATION

test · lint · integration · artifact

reproducible completion evidence
SANDBOX

isolation · lifecycle · resource limits

Sandbox is the boundary; runtime context is project semantics.
Core rule

Execution environment is part of the task input.

FIG.10.R2 · IDENTITY / POLICY MAIN PATH

The model proposes intent; PEP, PDP, and the credential broker determine real execution authority

IDENTITY

user + stable agent + runtime + task delegation

Who acts, on whose behalf, and why.
PEP

resolve actual resource + requested action

Enforce near execution; do not blindly trust model-provided resource identifiers.
PDP

policy decision

identity ∩ capability ∩ platform ∩ delegation ∩ runtime
CREDENTIAL BROKER

short-lived · scoped · target-bound

Long-lived credentials stay in the trusted control plane, not agent context.
RESOURCE

execute + audit + revoke / expire

tool · API · DB · deployment · MCP server
Final rule

The model proposes intent; the enforcement point resolves and authorizes the real resource.
